associations.rationale: Q8_simple_iso classifies simples by five named representations, but its displayed type does not state their dimensions.
The sum-of-squares identity is a consequence consistent with the irreducible dimensions, not their stated list.
Pairwise nonisomorphism supports distinctness of the listed representations but does not state the composite Q8 claim.
mem_center_iff directly identifies the center of Q8 as the two elements 1 and a^2, i.e. {±1}.
The equality directly states that Q8 has five conjugacy classes.
